raw_segments.text: He ended, and the sun gave signal high to the bright minister that watched.
He blew his trumpet, heard in Orib since perhaps when God descended, and perhaps once more
The angelic blast filled all the regions, from their blissful bowers of amaranthine
shade, fountain or spring, by the waters of life, where ere they sat in fellowships of
joy, the suns of light hasted, resorting to the summons high.
